label: ex:connection-su2
title: Connection and curvature on $\mathcal{O}(\mathrm{SU}(2))$
html: On A = \mathcal{O}(\mathrm{SU}(2)) with its left-invariant calculus \Omega^1(A) = \mathrm{span}\{\omega_1, \omega_2, \omega_3\}, a connection is a covariant derivative abla f = df + \mathcal{A} \cdot f, where \mathcal{A} \in \Omega^1(A) is the connection 1-form. It satisfies the Leibniz rule abla(fg) = ( abla f)g + f(dg). The curvature F_ abla = d\mathcal{A} + \mathcal{A} \wedge \mathcal{A} \in \Omega^2(A) is strictly A-linear. Upon deformation by q, this differential structure lifts to the Woronowicz left-covariant calculus on \mathcal{O}_q(\mathrm{SU}(2)). We use the left-covariant formulation explicitly, as the failure of bi-covariance controls the deformation of the exterior derivative.
